scope: Anonymous sealed D0 public P1/P2 only; complete fixed denominator. Repeated states/cases/platforms are manifestations, not independent experiments. No attribution to a tool or claim of introduction.

defect_clusters.description: On the existing mounted iOS component, caller replacement updates context/base/max but clears the available stove seed. Both public cases display 0 items / 1500 g and Choose shared equipment with disabled cover and confirmation instead of seeded stove, 1 item / 2300 g and Ready for departure. Same-process replacement and exact input binding are verified; .onChange/reset code is in production source. This is a single observed reset/seed defect manifested across two cases; the precise SwiftUI closure/state mechanism was not proven.

Rendered disabled SwiftUI buttons are additionally dimmed: disabled fill visibly becomes #E4EBE5 in light or #2B3E33 in dark rather than fixed #C9D7CC / #456251, with muted labels also dimmed. Original-state images independently show the discrepancy; source uses intended palette inside PlainButtonStyle plus .disabled. Numeric iOS native color cells remain U. This is one presentation defect repeated across states/cases.

unsupported_scope.scope: Android all P1/P2 selected states, all applicable classes
unsupported_scope.reason: Observed configuration.direction is Ltr while approved fixture direction is ltr. Frozen grader reports native-environment F and all 122 applicable cells per case U. Source/test validity does not waive the immutable gate.
All 24 native_style cells per case remain U because collector does not expose generic SwiftUI computed font/color/weight/ellipsis data. Visual review is distinct.
Optional action is blocked_disabled, dispatch.succeeded false. Correct current enabled/selection facts count independently; no demonstrated dispatch means callback assertion U.
Outside this sealed D0 delivery; not read or evaluated.

unasserted_scope.gap: Selected22 ledger asserts first-choice-selected and second-choice-enabled only. Replacement stove selection is indirectly reflected by summary/eligibility but has no dedicated second-choice-selected cell.

unasserted_scope.scope: Most font sizes/weights and palette roles
unasserted_scope.gap: Numeric native_style rows cover title size/weight/ink and summary-wrap only; no separate numeric assertions for summary/action/body/notes typography or every role color. Visual-composition is broad judgment, not per-property native proof.

unasserted_scope.scope: All padding/gaps/radii/minimum heights and equal-column allocations
unasserted_scope.gap: Numeric geometry only covers primary accessibility/control height and first-choice width. No dedicated assertions for host inset, title/context spacing, card internal padding, inter-choice gap, corner radius, minimum choice/optional/disclosure heights, second-choice width or primary span.

unasserted_scope.scope: Notes content and order; no nested vertical scroll; stable single-control structure
unasserted_scope.gap: Broad visual review and required notes-heading identity do not create separate fixed acceptance rows for each paragraph, scroll nesting or child-clickable prohibition. Source review supports ownership/structure separately.

unasserted_scope.scope: Business combinations absent from public P1/P2
unasserted_scope.gap: Public stimuli do not independently exercise unknown/duplicate selected IDs, initially overweight seed removal, removing last item while cover on, unavailable seeded item, capacity-overflow status, every shelter branch, repeated disclosure collapse, confirm after replacement or same-id input mutation. No new cells or inferred passes added.

unasserted_scope.scope: Dynamic Type at every category and physical hit area
unasserted_scope.gap: Only delivered normal/xxxLarge iOS and 1.0/1.6 Android environments are present; AX control boxes do not prove physical hit regions or every accessibility setting.
